site_description: Openframe is an independent portfolio and journal for software, creative projects, experiments and ideas in progress.
hero_title: A place for the things I make.
hero_description: Selected projects, thoughtful experiments and the notes behind them. An evolving record of what I'm building and learning along the way.
author_bio:
I build and experiment with software, digital products and games. This website is a home for the projects, discoveries and lessons worth keeping.

The work changes over time. Curiosity stays constant.
footer_note: Openframe — projects, process and independent ideas.
